arxiv-2012-05301.title: What Were They Thinking? Pharmacologic priors implicit in a choice of 3+3 dose-escalation design
arxiv-2012-05301.creator: David C. Norris
arxiv-2012-05301.description: Abstract If explicit, formal consideration of clinical pharmacology at all informs the design and conduct of modern oncology dose-finding trials, the designs themselves hardly attest to this. Yet in conducting a trial, investigators affirm that they hold reasonable expectations of participant safety—expectations that necessarily depend on beliefs about how certain pharmacologic parameters are distributed in the study population.

arxiv-2210-16107.creator: Xiaomin Lin, Cheng Liu, Allen Pattillo, Miao Yu, Yiannis Aloimonous
arxiv-2210-16107.description: Abstract Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are known for their speed and versatility in collecting aerial images and remote sensing for land use surveys and precision agriculture. With UAVs’ growth in availability and accessibility, they are now of vital importance as technological support in marine-based applications such as vessel monitoring and search-and-rescue (SAR) operations.

arxiv-2407-12400.creator: Suyoung Choi, Hyeontae Jang
arxiv-2407-12400.description: Abstract . A seed is a PL sphere that is not obtainable by a wedge operation from any other PL sphere. In this paper, we study two operations on PL spheres, known as the stellar subdivision and the wedge, that preserve the maximality of Buchstaber numbers and polytopality. We construct a new polytopal toric colorable seed from these two operations.

arxiv-2505-04211.description: Abstract To better understand the dependence of the magnetic field structure in the plasma edge due to plasma boundary shape, we define and develop umbilic stellarators. arxiv-2510-18450.description: Abstract . In this article we study Momentum Light Ray Transform (MLRT) on symmetric tensor fields. MLRT is an integral transform in time-space domain ( ( t , x ) ∈ ℝ 1 + n (t,x)\in\mathbb{R}^{1+n} ), which integrates a scalar function or a tensor field along the light rays with a polynomial type weight.

arxiv-2512-24420.title: Virasoro Symmetry in Neural Network Field Theories
arxiv-2512-24420.creator: Brandon Robinson
arxiv-2512-24420.description: Abstract Neural Network Field Theories (NN-FTs) can realize global conformal symmetries via embedding space architectures. These models describe Generalized Free Fields (GFFs) in the infinite width limit. However, they typically lack a local stress-energy tensor satisfying conformal Ward identities. This presents an obstruction to realizing infinite-dimensional, local conformal symmetry typifying 2d Conformal Field Theories (CFTs).

pmc-10650704.creator: Ahmad Zaheer Qureshi, Hasan Shacfe, Amara Ilyas, Saeed Bin Ayaz, Khalid Yousef Aljamaan, Imad Saeed Moukais, Mohammed Jameel, Waqas Sami, Sami Ullah, Marco Tramontano, Giovanni Galeoto

pmc-11645084.description: Recent advancements in patient rehabilitation integrate both traditional and modern techniques to enhance treatment efficacy and accessibility. The rehabilitation of upper limbs benefits from technologies like virtual reality and robotics which, when combined with hydrotherapy, can accelerate recovery.

pmc-11673575.title: Enhanced Biodiesel Production with Eversa Transform 2.0 Lipase on Magnetic Nanoparticles

Biodiesel was an alternative fuel composed mainly of fatty acid esters with strong transesterification and esterification capabilities.

pmc-11710005.creator: Dieu‐Trang Fuchs, Haoshen Shi, Nazanin Mirzaei, Yosef Koronyo, Miyah R Davis, Edward K Robinson, Altan Rentsendorj, Lon S S Schneider, Debra Hawes, Julie A Schneider, Keith L Black, Rakez Kayed, Maj‐Linda B Selenica, Daniel C Lee, Maya Koronyo‐Hamaoui

In the pathogenesis of AD, the tau protein undergoes post‐translational modifications, including hyperphosphorylation (p‐tau).

pmc-12640776.title: Impact of Pre-Hospital and in-Hospital Optimization on the Management of Intravenous Thrombolysis in Hyperacute Ischemic Stroke: A Scoping Review
pmc-12640776.creator: Talitha Elvina Ayu Kharisma, Lisda Amalia, Lika Apriani, Fathul Huda, Aih Cahyani
pmc-12640776.description: IntroductionStroke is the second leading cause of death worldwide and ranks third as a cause of disability. The American Heart Association/American Stroke Association (AHA/ASA) recommends that treatment begin within three hours of onset with intravenous thrombolysis therapy. This scoping review aimed to identify the factors that influence the delay in intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) management in patients with ischemic stroke.

pmc-12829223.title: A comprehensive mobile nutritional application is associated with improved time efficiency and user experience in managing hospitalized children with malnutrition
pmc-12829223.creator: Settachote Maholarnkij, Chonnikant Visuthranukul, Eakkarin Mekangkul, Jaraspong Uaariyapanichkul, Sirinuch Chomtho

Novel technologies have been shown to encourage healthcare teams to initiate nutritional management and reduce the workload of nutrition support teams.

pmc-13081769.title: Assessing Long‐Term Changes in Endometrial Morphology and Functionality in Dairy Cows With Metritis
pmc-13081769.creator: M. H. Rashid, A. Martelo Pereira, F. N. S. Pereira, M. C. Oliveira Costa, E. F. Santos, L. Christensen, J. A. Sexton, M. Ciccarelli, L. B. Williams, M. Binelli, M. S. Waqas, E. B. de Oliveira, C. C. Figueiredo
pmc-13081769.description: This study evaluated the long‐term impact of metritis on endometrial morphology and functionality in dairy cows. Postpartum Holstein cows (n = 107) were enrolled in a cohort study at the University of Idaho Dairy Center. Metritis was diagnosed using a Metricheck device within 12 days in milk (DIM) based on the presence of fetid, watery, reddish‐brown vaginal discharge (VD).

pmc-13100149.title: Mathematical modeling of planar cell polarity: principles, approaches, and open questions
pmc-13100149.creator: Mohd Suhail Rizvi, Mohit Kumar Jolly
pmc-13100149.description: Planar cell polarity represents a fundamental mechanism by which cells within epithelial sheets align their orientation, enabling coordinated tissue morphogenesis and function. Disruption of PCP leads to developmental defects and disease, highlighting the importance of understanding its establishment and maintenance.

pmc-13125496.title: Conducting polymer-stabilized nanozymes alleviate sepsis-induced myocardial injury by inhibiting iron accumulation and lipid peroxidation
pmc-13125496.creator: Tingting Wu, Ying Liu, Wei Wang, Rong Sun, Yanyan Wang, Jiangpeng Pan, Jingfei Zhu, Kelong Fan, Qiuran Xu, Wei Jiang
pmc-13125496.description: Septic cardiomyopathy (SC) is a severe complication of sepsis that significantly increases patient mortality. The onset of SC is associated with excessive reactive oxygen species (ROS), leading to increased oxidative stress and iron accumulation. Herein, we develop a library of conductive polypyrrole-polythiophene copolymer (PPy-co-PTh)-stabilized nanozymes by coordinating different metal ions within the copolymer framework.

pmc-13313345.title: Learning in a noisy world: How lucky successes and unlucky failures shape learning consequences
pmc-13313345.creator: Amanda Zaidan Chen, Martha Jeong, Michele Rigolizzo, Annesha Sil, Nicola Vasta, Nicola Vasta, Nicola Vasta
pmc-13313345.description: Learning is noisy. People can face unlucky failure, in which they fail despite using effective strategies, or experience lucky success, in which they succeed in spite of using suboptimal strategies. Both situations can serve as potentially valuable learning opportunities, as long as performance outcomes are interpreted accurately.

pmc-13462090.title: m6A modification-mediated lncRNA UNC5B-AS1 enhances HCC progression through miR-760/IL6 axis
pmc-13462090.creator: Li-ping Yu, Sheng-yu Huang, Kun-peng Li, Jun-sheng Ni, Zhi-ping Huang, Zhou-feng Deng
pmc-13462090.description: WT1-associated protein (WTAP)-catalyzed m6A methylation drives oncogenic processes in HCC. Long noncoding RNA UNC5B-AS1 are associated with various types of cancer including hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Previous study indicated that UNC5B-AS1 promotes HCC progression. uslaw-usc-t15-s8801.title: 15 U.S.C. § 8801 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t15-s8801.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s8801.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 114 (National Quantum Initiative). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) Advisory Committee The term “Advisory Committee” means the National Quantum Initiative Advisory Committee established under section 8814(a) of this title. (2) Appropriate committees of Congress The term “appropriate committees of Congress” means— (A) the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
